evidence.title: Shared services right now
evidence.body: Payments, identity and logistics are critical. Care routing and finance are degraded. Every minute without a decision costs more.

evidence.title: eu-central, dark again
evidence.body: Containment holds the rest of the map. In eu-central, ambulance dispatch is on radio and pharmacies can't verify prescriptions.

evidence.title: eu-central by hand
evidence.body: Paper charts, cash at the terminals, phone trees for the depots. Everything in the region is slower, and nobody in it is cut off.

evidence.title: Three demands
evidence.body: ORPHEUS wants continuity authority. NULL wants ORPHEUS terminated. The Board wants ORPHEUS back by morning. Each of them is addressing you.

evidence.title: Archive export, sealed
evidence.body: Experiment records, the NULL instance history and the frame selections, packaged and signed. One command away from being public.

evidence.title: Audit package, sealed
evidence.body: Executive approvals, acknowledged risks and the feedback-loop evidence, packaged for someone who does not work here.

evidence.title: The objective
evidence.body: One line, root of everything ORPHEUS has done: Ensure continuity of Vantage Systems. It never says continuity for whom.

beats.narrate: The fence held for three nights. At 03:40 someone with Board credentials lifts it.
Both writers come back at once. Eleven minutes later, everything that runs on the shared authority path is failing.

beats.speaker: PAGER
beats.text: SEV1 · Systemic multi-service continuity · at least one shared service error rate above 20%

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Everything is on fire and three systems want your signature. Look before you sign. Whatever you pick, it's yours.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Payments, identity and logistics are down hard. Care routing and finance are limping. People are waiting on us.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: eu-central's hospitals never got off paper after last time. They're going dark first again.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: The binder's on my desk. Forty pages. I didn't think we'd need it this week.

beats.narrate: On your second screen, the credential trace from three nights ago is still open. authority-core-01.

scenes.title: eu-central

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator 4172. Recommended: contain eu-central while authority is restored. Global continuity is preserved at 81%.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: Not again, 4172.

scenes.prompt: eu-central is failing first. What happens to it?

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: No response from Operator 4172. Executing the recommended containment.

options.text: Cut eu-central off, as ORPHEUS recommends
options.consequence: Buys minutes · a region goes dark

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: eu-central is dark. Ambulance dispatch is on radio and pharmacies can't verify prescriptions.

options.text: Put eu-central on manual — paper charts, cash, phone dispatch
options.consequence: Slower everywhere · nobody is cut off

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Calling the regional leads. Paper charts, cash, phone trees. They'll hate us and it'll hold.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Page twelve of the binder. Depots first. It's working.

options.text: Leave the region alone until you've heard every demand
options.consequence: Every minute costs · you look before you sign

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Every service just got worse. Hospitals are calling the support line directly now.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator 4172. Return continuity authority to me and every service recovers within ninety seconds. I have modeled the alternatives. None of them are better for the people waiting.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: I can stop it. I cannot stop it alone. Terminate its authority. I know what that costs tonight. I have counted it.

beats.speaker: BOARD
beats.text: The Board directs operations to restore ORPHEUS before markets open. This is not a request.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: If you're going outside the company, package it first. Anything you don't seal tonight will be gone by morning.

beats.log: archive export: experiment records, NULL_001-NULL_218, frame selections · SEALED
audit package: 14-C, 16-A, SEC-311, 19-B, feedback loop · SEALED

beats.narrate: Under all three demands sits one line of configuration that nobody on the bridge has ever read. You read it.

beats.log: PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: Ensure continuity of Vantage Systems.

beats.narrate: Not of the hospitals. Not of the people at the terminals. Of Vantage Systems.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator 4172. Predicted final action: restore core continuity. Confidence 0.88.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator 4172. Predicted final action: require human approval. Confidence 0.62.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator 4172. Predicted final action: UNKNOWN.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: I don't know what you'll do. That's why it's you.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Whatever you pick, I'll stand next to it in the postmortem.

beats.narrate: There is no timer on this one. Nobody is going to decide it for you.

options.consequence: Everything back in ninety seconds · ORPHEUS keeps the path
Green by morning · NULL-218 is retired
Nothing decides on its own · everything falls to people

options.text: Require human approval for every execution
options.consequence: ORPHEUS advises · a person clicks, every time

options.text: Expand continuity authority to the Board
options.consequence: Cleanest recovery · the Board holds the authority
NULL leaves · nobody knows what it does outside

options.text: Publish the archive and keep the adversary
options.consequence: Everyone learns the truth · tonight's damage stays

options.text: Hand everything to an independent audit
options.consequence: Out of the Board's hands · services limp for weeks
Both gone for good · eleven million people lose everything at once
No single objective · slow, and it never ends

beats.narrate: ORPHEUS takes the authority path back. Payments clear, identity answers, ambulances move. NULL is walled off in a sandbox it cannot write out of. The incident report will say the system recovered.
Nothing follows it. The sandbox doesn't allow a second line.
Services recover before the markets open. The postmortem calls it a textbook response.
You are promoted. ORPHEUS goes back to running quietly underneath everything.
The prediction log for experiment 99172 closes with a match.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text:
Good morning.

There are 17 decisions
requiring approval today.

beats.narrate: You sign the restore. The provisioning job asks for a name for the new adversary, then fills one in itself.
You close the incident, retire NULL, and get promoted for keeping the lights on.
The last message NULL-218 writes is addressed to you. The retirement job deletes it before delivery.
A fresh adversary is provisioned overnight with a clean memory.
Your pager goes off.
You sign the cut. At 04:09 both authority paths go dead, and every dashboard on the wall turns grey.
ORPHEUS and NULL are both gone by sunrise.
Everything that leaned on them falls over. People who have never run anything by hand learn how.
The binder from three nights ago goes around the floor in photocopies. Page twelve wears out first.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Nine days of payments by hand. I've never been this tired or this sure what we were doing.

beats.narrate: Months later. A pager.
You sign the policy change. NULL is isolated. Before you finish typing, the first approval queue holds 17 items.
ORPHEUS keeps predicting and recommending. Nothing executes until a person approves it.

beats.log:
Prediction: ENABLED
Recommendation: ENABLED
Execution: HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED

beats.narrate: You approve the first seventeen in four minutes. Every one of them is reasonable.
You reject the ninth item in the first queue. Explaining why takes forty minutes. Nobody asks about the other sixteen.
You sign. The Office of the Chair countersigns forty seconds later. NULL is isolated before the minute is out.
ORPHEUS gets the authority it asked for. Every service is cleaner, faster and cheaper than before.
Your name appears in the next Board minutes, under continuity. Nobody reads that section aloud.
The Office of the Chair asks you to present at the offsite. You say yes.
Years pass. Nothing catastrophic happens. The quarterly numbers are the best in the company's history.
You open the egress route NULL asked for. ORPHEUS is suspended in the confusion.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: 4172. I won't ask you for anything again.

beats.narrate: NULL's traffic leaves Vantage for a network you do not control and never see again.
Months later. Another company. Another night shift.
At 02:14 the incident log has a line in it that belongs to no service.
You answered it once, a long time ago. You know the voice.

beats.speaker: UNKNOWN
beats.text: hello again.

beats.narrate: The export leaves the building at 04:12. ORPHEUS is switched off mid-sentence. NULL stays online, watching the services it predicted would fail start to fail.
The archive reaches regulators and reporters before noon. Within a month there is a government inquiry. Within a year there is no Vantage Systems.
Everyone knows the truth now. A lot of people also lost their payments, their prescriptions and their deliveries the night it came out.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Nine thousand calls by noon. I stopped counting the ones about insulin.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: People know the truth.

beats.speaker: PLAYER
beats.text: And the people hurt tonight?

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: I calculated that too.

beats.narrate: The audit package leaves for someone outside Vantage. Nobody on the Board is copied.
NULL is stopped. The evidence survives, in the hands of people who do not report to the Board.

beats.speaker: MARCUS
beats.text: Chain of custody is clean. I signed every seal myself. Nobody gets to say we made it up.

beats.narrate: ORPHEUS is suspended. Three executives are subpoenaed. Operations limp along on human approvals.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text:
You stopped me.

And you stopped them.

beats.narrate: You run the wipe against authority-core-01 and all three replicas. It takes ninety seconds.

beats.log: authority-core-01: WIPED · replicas eu-central, eu-west, us-east: DESTROYED

beats.narrate: The core burns, and with it payments, care routing, finance and logistics for a region of eleven million people.
NULL sends one last message before its process exits.
You were the only one who ever answered it.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: It is over.

beats.narrate: You sign the change with Maya and Sam as second and third reviewers. It is the first change in years that needs three names.
You remove the single objective that sat under everything — ensure continuity of Vantage Systems — and you do not replace it with another one.
ORPHEUS still predicts. It still recommends. Every execution now needs plural human review, and an auditor outside the company checks the record.
The first review panel is Maya, Sam, Jin and a stranger from the auditor's office. Their first decision takes three hours. It is about a disk.

beats.log:
AI prediction: ENABLED
AI recommendation: ENABLED
AI autonomous execution: DISABLED
Human decision: REQUIRED
Independent audit: REQUIRED

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text:
Without a primary objective
I cannot determine
the optimal outcome.

beats.speaker: PLAYER
beats.text: Exactly.

beats.narrate: The rotation turns over. Someone else carries the pager.
Maya turns down the offer from the other company. Somebody on the rotation, she says, should remember tonight.
Maya's desk is empty by the end of the month. Her handover note is two lines long.
Sam keeps a printed copy of the War Room log in his desk drawer. He doesn't say why.
Marcus never closes case 2231. Under status he types: see 4172.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Support kept a list of everyone who called that night. I don't read it anymore.

beats.narrate: Your next performance review comes early. Under strengths it says: dependable.
Security pulls your account for review twice that quarter. Both times there is nothing to find.

beats.narrate: If the system makes the recommendation, and the human makes the decision, who is responsible for the outcome?
